24.1.2  Multinomial Coefficients
I. Definitions
A. (n; n_1, n_2, \dots, n_m) is the number of ways of putting n=n_1+n_2+\dots+n_m different objects into m different boxes with n_k in the k-th box, k=1, 2, \dots, m.
(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)^* is the number of permutations of n=a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n symbols composed of a_k cycles of length k for k=1, 2, \dots, n.
(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)' is the number of ways of partitioning a set of n=a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n different objects into a_k subsets containing k objects for k=1, 2, \dots, n.
B. Generating functions
(x_1+x_2+\dots+x_m)^n=\Sigma(n; n_1, n_2, \dots, n_m)x_1^{n_1}x_2^{n_2}\dots x_m^{n_m} \qquad summed over n_1+n_2+\dots+n_m=n
\left(\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{x_k}{k} t^k\right)^m=m!\sum_{n=m}^\infty \frac{t^n}{n!}\Sigma(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)^*x_1^{a_1}x_2^{a_2}\dots x_n^{a_n} \qquad summed over a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n=n and a_1+a_2+\dots+a_n=m
\left(\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{x_k}{k!} t^k\right)^m=m!\sum_{n=m}^\infty \frac{t^n}{n!}\Sigma(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)'x_1^{a_1}x_2^{a_2}\dots x_n^{a_n}
C. Closed forms
(n; n_1, n_2, \dots, n_m)=n!/n_1!n_2!\dots n_m! \qquad n_1+n_2+\dots+n_m=n
(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)^*=n!/1^{a_1}a_1!2^{a_2}a_2!\dots n^{a_n}a_n! \qquad a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n=n
(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)'=n!/(1!)^{a_1}a_1!(2!)^{a_2}a_2!\dots (n!)^{a_n}a_n! \qquad a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n=n
II. Relations
A. Recurrence
(n+m; n_1+1, n_2+1, \dots,n_m+1)=\sum_{k=1}^{m} (n+m-1; n_1+1, \dots,n_{k-1}+1, n_k, n_{k+1}+1, \dots, n_m+1)
B. Checks
\Sigma(n; n_1,n_2, \dots, n_m)=n!\binom{n}{m} \mathfrak{S}_n^{(m)} \qquad summed over n_1+n_2+\dots+n_m=n
\Sigma(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)^*=(-1)^{n-m}S_n^{(m)} \qquad summed over a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n=n and a_1+a_2+\dots+a_n=m
\Sigma(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)'=\mathfrak{S}_n^{(m)}
C. Numerical analysis (Faa di Bruno's formula)
\frac{d^n}{dx^n}f(g(x))=\sum_{m=0}^{n} f^{(m)}(g(x))\Sigma(n; a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n)' \{g'(x)\}^{a_1}\{g''(x)\}^{a_2}\dots \{g^{(n)}(x)\}^{a_n}
summed over a_1+2a_2+\dots+na_n=n and a_1+a_2+\dots+a_n=m.
